title: Replication package and interactive companion for "Rare on screens but on everyone's mind: a systematic review of misinformation prevalence, exposure, and concentration" (dataset v1.7.26)

creators.name: Hitz, Laura
creators.affiliation: Center for Philanthropy Studies, University of Basel

description:
Replication package and interactive companion for the systematic review "Rare on screens but on everyone's mind: a systematic review of misinformation prevalence, exposure, and concentration".

Frozen dataset v1.7.26: 1,201 estimates from 512 studies, MD5 78b81f58f9c3d315cdb4747672957b16.

Everything needed to reproduce the paper's numbers, figures and tables from one frozen dataset: the dataset, the analysis scripts and their run order, the methods and the append-only research log, the search queries, and the companion website.
